summary: Reviewed pre-existing 4-scenario Gherkin draft against Jira's 5 ACs. Found no negative/validation scenario, no scenario for acting on another user's specific record (distinct from the existing read-scoping scenario), and no scenario actually exercising AC3's Follow-Through Rate formula -- added 3 scenarios to close these gaps (7 total). Flagged two open questions for Tech Lead: (1) FINTRACK-21's recommendation handler is explicitly compute-on-read with no persisted instance, but this story requires a stable per-recommendation identity to act on -- architecture decision needed, not prescribed here; (2) AC5 ("feeds back into future recommendation prioritisation") is unspecified beyond one line and may be undersized at 3 points alongside a new persisted entity and a time-based auto-transition job. Transitioned BACKLOG -> IN_ANALYSIS.
